fail_to_pass._summary: 17 integration tests in crates/ruff/tests/{format,lint}.rs covering the new CLI configuration-override surface (--config 'key=value', --config <file>, --extend-select, --isolated handling, conflict detection, deprecated-option handling). Each invokes the `ruff` binary via TestContext and asserts CLI output via insta snapshots — system-level by definition (CLI is the public surface).

triage.module_scope_rationale: crates/ruff hosts the CLI binary that this KIP modifies.

pass_to_pass_expansion_summary.policy: All added P2P selectors are pre-existing Ruff integration tests added to p2p.txt; p2p_aug.txt remains reserved for synthesized augmented P2P tests.
pass_to_pass_expansion_summary.validation: Expanded original suite validated pre-state and post-state with 50/50 P2P passing; union coverage executed 51/51 P2P selectors including the unchanged synthesized augmented P2P selector.
pass_to_pass_expansion_summary.candidate_source: Pre-existing crates/ruff/tests/integration_test.rs selectors plus the original show_settings and resolve_files P2P selectors.

coverage_gate.measurement_note: Coverage measured with cargo-llvm-cov over solution.patch Rust lines; union mode runs original plus augmented F2P/P2P selectors. Original P2P was expanded to 50 pre-existing selectors on 2026-06-15.

triage.test_level_policy: All augmented selectors exercise Ruff through the public `ruff` CLI binary using cargo integration tests. The F2P selectors use user-visible command-line behavior for repeatable inline `--config` overrides and add-noqa file discovery; the P2P selector uses default lint behavior with no configuration overrides.

requirement_sections: Allow override of configuration options via the CLI > Proposals
config_aug::isolated_inline_overrides_st.public_surface: ruff check --isolated with repeatable inline --config TOML options.
config_aug::isolated_inline_overrides_st.rationale: The requirement permits inline CLI configuration overrides. `--isolated` ignores configuration files, but inline CLI overrides remain command-line input; this test selects E501 and lowers line-length through inline `--config`, distinguishing the mutant that drops ConfigArguments in isolated mode.

requirement_sections: Allow override of configuration options via the CLI > Proposals
config_aug::nested_pyproject_add_noqa_us.public_surface: ruff check --add-noqa over a directory with a nested pyproject.toml and an inline --config exclude override.
config_aug::nested_pyproject_add_noqa_us.rationale: CLI overrides must transform every resolved configuration, including nested pyproject.toml files discovered while collecting files for add-noqa. The mutant substitutes default ConfigArguments during file discovery, so the nested generated.py file is not excluded and gets modified.

requirement_sections: Allow override of configuration options via the CLI > Proposals
config_aug::default_check_still_reports_.public_surface: ruff check default CLI behavior without --config overrides.
config_aug::default_check_still_reports_.rationale: Pins unrelated default lint behavior for unused imports so the configuration-override patch does not regress ordinary no-config CLI checks.
